mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks increase.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions when UNRATE rises, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and GDPC1 decline, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%), persistent inflation pressures lead the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
